name: line-chart
title: Line chart
description: Show how one or more values change across an ordered axis, with straight or stepped lines.
a11y: The chart is role=img with the required title as its name.
A visually hidden table lists every value, one row per category, for screen readers.
One focusable stop per category with a spoken label; Arrow keys move between them and Escape hides the tooltip.
The value tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus.
Series differ by dash pattern and marker shape as well as colour, and the legend names them.
